beginner.why: The slant and horizontal hookloads need the capstone's 1500 kg/m3 mud, which no explorer took, and printed in kN to 3 dp against tol 0.5 N. W4a gives all three explorers a mud density box (blank means the lessons' 1440) and prints hookloads in N to 2 dp. The brief now names the box. Prompt only.
prompt_edits: Six numbers from three wells, at a mud density of 1500 kg/m3.
Six numbers from three wells, at a mud density of 1500 kg/m3. Type 1500 into the string explorer's mud density box and its views run this case, with hookloads in newtons to two decimals.

advanced.why: The torsion utilization and the wear need the 1500 kg/m3 mud, and the wear needs the two-entry schedule, where the wear view took one entry at 120 rpm. prompt_edits: (6) the worst WALL LOSS as a percentage from the same run.
